text: oh I do hate to trouble you at this hour. I've got my grandson staying, he's 3, and he just will not settle tonight, up and down, up and down. He's got a runny nose, bit blocked too, and he's been sneezing all evening. Otherwise he seems fine in himself. I expect it's just a cold and I'm being a silly old worrier but his mum always says to check. Sorry dear.
